mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_order WHERE deleted = FALSE AND status = 'CONFIRMED'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(settlement_total_amount), 0) FROM sales_order WHERE deleted = FALSE AND status = 'CONFIRMED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer WHERE deleted = FALSE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM supplier WHERE deleted = FALSE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_sku WHERE deleted = FALSE

SELECT item.product_name_snapshot AS name, COALESCE(SUM(item.settlement_line_amount), 0) AS amount FROM sales_order_item item JOIN sales_order so ON so.id = item.order_id WHERE item.deleted = FALSE AND so.deleted = FALSE AND so.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND so.created_at >= #{startTime} AND so.created_at < #{endTime} GROUP BY item.sku_id, item.product_name_snapshot ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) FROM inventory_balance WHERE deleted = FALSE
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sku_id) FROM inventory_balance WHERE deleted = FALSE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warehouse WHERE deleted = FALSE AND status = 'ENABLED'

SELECT w.name AS warehouseName, COALESCE(SUM(b.quantity), 0) AS quantity FROM inventory_balance b JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = b.warehouse_id WHERE b.deleted = FALSE AND w.deleted = FALSE GROUP BY b.warehouse_id, w.name ORDER BY quantity DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_order WHERE deleted = FALSE
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM purchase_order WHERE deleted = FALSE
